findings.reason: English names the action 'Download {name}', but the Hindi accessible name only repeats the visible 'Get' word, so a screen-reader user never hears that the button downloads the agent. The parenthetical keeps the required visible-word containment and changes no visible layout; the alternative is to pair card.get: 'डाउनलोड' with aria '{name} डाउनलोड करें', at the cost of a longer visible label.

The same English term 'Last modified' already ships as 'आखिरी बदलाव' in ui.settings.configuration.settings_page.last_modified and 'आखिरी बदलाव:' in ui.settings.model.system_prompt.last_modified; 'अंतिम बदलाव' is a second rendering of one term on a metadata line that sits beside the shipped 'Created' word.

English is the one word 'Delist'; the Hindi repeats the title's whole phrase (6 -> 13 codepoints) in a maxWidth xs dialog footer beside 'रद्द करें'. The locale's shipped confirm buttons use the bare verb (ui.chat.dialogs.delete_action, ui.agents.dialogs.delete.confirm both 'हटाएँ'), and the title and body already name the object. Optional; if kept, check this footer in a rendered pass.

observations.about: translator judgement call: पाएँ for Get
observations.evidence: Shipped hi renders 'Get' as पाएँ in ui.providers.provider_detail.get_a_sign_in_code ('साइन इन कोड पाएँ') and ui.onboarding.search.row.get_your ('अपनी {name} पाएँ'), and card.get's note requires a short word for the narrow footer; 'डाउनलोड' is this locale's download term (ui.library.menu.download 'डाउनलोड करें', ui.hub.skills.download). Containment of the visible word in the aria is exact. The cost of using Get (not Download) in the aria is recorded as finding 1.

observations.about: translator judgement call: delist wording (सूची से हटाएँ)
observations.evidence: No shipped English or hi 'delist' term exists (the only delist strings are this namespace), so there is no glossary drift to inherit. 'सूची से हटाना' is the locale's removal-from-a-list idiom (ui.agentMessages.settings 'किसी को सूची से हटाने पर ...'), and the six delist strings are internally consistent: aria, title, tooltip, body, spinner and failure all use the same सूची से हटा- stem. 'डीलिस्ट करें' would be jargon; it was not used. Only the confirm button's length is recorded, as nit 3.

observations.about: translator judgement call: लाइक for like
observations.evidence: No shipped hi 'like' term exists (all लाइक occurrences are this namespace), so no drift. लाइक is the ordinary Hindi web transliteration for the social action and keeps the heart distinct from पसंदीदा, which already ships as 'पसंदीदा बनाएँ' / 'पसंदीदा से हटाएँ' in ui.library.menu.favorite / unfavorite and is reused verbatim here. 'एजेंट का लाइक हटाएँ' is the normal 'remove the like on X' construction, parallel to 'पसंदीदा से हटाएँ'.

observations.about: translator judgement call: age placed first in card.updated
observations.evidence: Hindi is verb-final, and the shipped locale already uses the age-first construction: ui.hub.updates '{ago} अपडेट किया गया।' and ui.code_review '{amount} घंटे पहले अपडेट हुआ'. With ui.hub.comments.age.hours = '{count} घंटे पहले', card.updated reads '2 घंटे पहले अपडेट किया गया' — complete, natural, and with no second preposition. details.created ('बनाया गया: {age} ({date})') and details.last_modified keep the labelled-line order, which is also correct because the age itself carries पहले.

observations.about: translator judgement call: curly quotes in tooltip_unknown and delist_body
observations.evidence: The locale already ships “ ” in user-facing copy (ui.chat.tags, ui.projects, ui.schedule, ui.teamBridge), and the quotes scope the negated state word 'पसंदीदा नहीं' / 'लाइक नहीं' and the agent name in the delist body. No NFC or bidi issue; the source's straight quotes are typography, not a placeholder.

observations.about: translator judgement call: Radient kept Latin
observations.evidence: The context notes for the three signed-out strings say Radient is a product name and stays English; it is the only Latin token in the file. Agent Hub is rendered as the shipped एजेंट हब (ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub, ui.command_palette), which is the locale's established surface name.

observations.about: Created by rendered as निर्माता while Unknown author uses लेखक
observations.evidence: The English terms differ ('Created by: {author}' vs 'Unknown author'), so the two-word choice is not one English term rendered two ways. 'निर्माता: {author}' reads naturally as a metadata label; 'अज्ञात लेखक' reads naturally on the card. Watch only if a future visible 'Author:' label is added.

observations.about: viewer_unknown renders 'viewer state' as आपकी स्थिति
observations.evidence: The preceding clause names लाइक और पसंदीदा, so 'इस एजेंट के लिए आपकी स्थिति' is scoped to those reactions rather than a generic account status; 'व्यूअर स्थिति' would be jargon in hi. No change needed.
